title: LangGraph: Cyclical Graphs & Multi-Step Agent Workflows
why: Standard LangChain chains are strictly linear (Directed Acyclic Graphs). Real-world agents require cyclic execution loops, conditional branching, human approval gates, and state persistence. LangGraph is the production standard for controllable agent workflows.
objectives: Model agents as StateGraph nodes and edges
Implement conditional edges for tool routing
concept: In LangGraph, state flows through nodes. Nodes are Python functions that modify state. Edges determine which node runs next based on current state attributes.

practice.description: Define a conditional routing function that checks if an agent output contains the word 'APPROVED' and routes to 'deploy_node' or 'revision_node'.

requirements: Node 3: Final synthesizer with conditional human approval edge

checklist: Understood state checkpointing and human-in-the-loop mechanisms
mistakes: Creating infinite cycles without conditional edges that guarantee termination
